turns.text: Thanks. It helps hearing that. I've just got to figure out steps that I can manage.

turns.speaker: supporter
turns.text: Absolutely. Maybe start small—taking small breaks during the day or planning something relaxing, even if it's just for an hour.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: That's a good idea. I think I can start with that and see how it goes. Thank you for being there. It always helps talking things out.

turns.speaker: supporter
turns.text: Anytime. I'm glad you reached out. You're never alone in this. Keep in touch, okay?

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: I will. Thanks again for listening. It means a lot.
